title: Insomnia TCM Mining — Reproducible Experiment Package for Apriori Association Rule and Complex Network Analysis of Insomnia Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescriptions
description: An end-to-end, single-command reproducible pipeline (eleven Python scripts, a Makefile, and a docx-js paper builder) that derives all numerical results, eight figures and eight tables of the accompanying manuscript from two minimum-necessary CSV inputs containing only the fields prescription_id and herb. Designed so that any third party can independently verify the reported numbers via a single `make all` command.
